translate_en|mods/KI5EngineSounds/common: Shows family, rpm, load, the road inputs and the playing layers of every vehicle played, and writes them to console.txt once a second.
Loudness of the engines this mod plays, with their start and stop. The game's own Vehicle Engine volume (audio options) applies on top, as it does to vanilla engines.
Only the nearest vehicles with a running engine are played.
Road sounds play only for the nearest vehicles whose engine is heard.
Loudness of the tyres on asphalt, gravel and grass, skids, brakes and a bare rim. Separate from the engine volume; the game's own Vehicle Engine volume applies on top.
